sandbachFocus: Sandbach United's disappointing away performance at Dawley Town ended in a 3-1 defeat, extending their recent struggles with a second consecutive loss. The league leaders were undone by soft goals conceded either side of half-time, with Dawley capitalizing on defensive errors. Despite a spirited final 20 minutes that saw them pull one goal back from a penalty, Sandbach couldn't salvage anything from the game on what proved to be a difficult away fixture.
divisionWide: Eccleshall delivered a dominant 5-0 home thrashing of Shawbury United, showcasing excellent attacking play and defensive solidity throughout. New Mills secured an impressive 5-2 victory over Wednesfield Community in an entertaining encounter. Stafford Town cruised past Telford Town 3-1 at home, maintaining their strong form with three goals in the first half. Wolverhampton Casuals eased to a 4-0 victory over Allscott Heath in the second half after leading 1-0 at the break. Barnton claimed a 2-0 away win at Foley Meir to continue their excellent recent run. Cheadle Heath Nomads drew 1-1 with Brereton Social in a closely contested match. Matches between Widnes Town and Alsager Town were scheduled but no confirmed scoreline is available.
